last June-everybody but Bob Mathouser, Omaha, Neb., that is. Bob's #15-Federal Engineering Special got
out of hand and he spun putting him out. Leading the pack is Chuck Stevenson, Garden Grove, Calif. (#45-
Bardahl Special) followed by #89-John Conely, Brighton, Mich.; #28-Troy Ruttman, Dearborn, Mich.; #53-Bud
Tingelstad, Dayton, Ohio; #61-Bob Christie, Grant's Pass, Ore.; #37-Ed Kostenuk, Victoria, B. C.; #43-Bob
Harkey, Charlotte, N. C.; #49-Art Malone, Tampa, Fla., and #39-Ed Hoyle, Walpole, Mass. Tingelstad won the
race but the plaudits went to Conely who spun twice but still came on to finish second.
